an4.138:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo nikaṭṭhakāyo hoti anikaṭṭhacitto?
an4.138:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati,
an4.138:2.3: so tattha kāmavitakkam pi vitakketi vyāpādavitakkam pi vitakketi vihiṃsāvitakkam pi vitakketi.
an4.138:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo nikaṭṭhakāyo hoti anikaṭṭhacitto. 3.
an4.138:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo anikaṭṭhakāyo hoti nikaṭṭhacitto?
an4.138:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo na h' eva kho araññe . . . patisevati,
an4.138:3.3: so tattha nekkhammavitakkam pi vitakketi avyāpādavitakkam . . . avihiṃsāvitakkaṃ vitakketi.
an4.138:3.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo anikaṭṭhakāyo hoti nikaṭṭhacitto. 4.
an4.138:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo anikaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti anikaṭṭhacitto ca?
an4.138:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo na h' eva kho araññe . . . paṭisevati,
an4.138:4.3: so tattha kāmavitakkaṃ pi vitakketi . . . vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ vitakketi.
an4.138:4.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave anikaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti anikaṭṭhacitto ca. 5.
an4.138:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo nikaṭṭhakāyo ca hoti nikaṭṭhacitto ca?
an4.138:5.2: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo araññe . . . paṭisevati,
an4.138:5.3: so tattha nekkhammavitakkam pi vitakketi avyāpādavitakkam pi vitakketi avihiṃsāvitakkam pi vitakketi.
an4.138:5.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo nikaṭṭhakayo ca hoti nikaṭṭhacitto ca.
an4.138:5.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 139. 1.
